attchmntText: The Board considered and approved the Un-Audited Standalone and ConsolidatedFinancial Results of the Company for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30thSeptember, 2026, along with the Limited Review Reports issued by the StatutoryAuditors of the Company thereon
voiceSummary: Onelife Capital Advisors Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half Year ended 30 September 2026. The Board deferred consideration of the proposed Rights Issue due to non-finalization of relevant documents. The proposal will be placed before the Board at a subsequent meeting. The auditor’s review report highlights the conversion of 56,41,162 share warrants of Swojas Foods Limited into equity shares between July 2026 and September 2026, upon payment of ₹698.09 lakh. As of 30 September 2026, 27,58,838 share warrants remained outstanding. The consolidated results include subsidiaries Dealmoney Distribution and Advisory Services Private Limited, Dealmoney Commodities Private Limited, Eyelid Infrastructure Private Limited, Dealmoney Insurance Broking Private Limited, Sarsan Securities Private Limited, Dealmoney Financial Services Private Limited, Dealmoney Real State Private Limited, and Dealmoney Distribution and E Marketing Private Limited.

attchmntText: Onelife Capital Advisors Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
